newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France injects 600 mln Ffr at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France injects 600 mln Ffr at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France injected 600 million francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Monday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Tuesday
It accepted bids for 36 billion francs in new liquidity, 600 million more than the 35.4 billion leaving the market on Tuesday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on July 16.
The Bank of France said it allocated 10.5 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 3.4 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 25.5 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 10.9 percent of this demand.
